pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 COMPARATIVE AND SUPERLATIVE ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to make comparisons in life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify comparative and superlative adjectives in texts
2. use comparative and superlative adjectives in communication

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify comparative and superlative adjectives in texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify comparative and superlative adjectives in texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use comparative and superlative adjectives in communication
   In simple words: practise until you can use comparative and superlative adjectives in communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives.
4. Show that you can: identify comparative and superlative adjectives in texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using comparative and superlative adjectives,
2. Play language games featuring adjectives,
3. Learning to learn: It is developed as the learner organises their learning and searches online or offline for examples of comparative and superlative adjectives.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify comparative and superlative adjectives in texts
2. use comparative and superlative adjectives in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
